endings.description_id: Dimas menolak tawaran Rudi. Ia memilih jalan keras tapi jujur. Hidup sederhana tapi tenang bersama Raka.
endings.description_en: Dimas refuses Rudi's offer. He chooses the hard but honest path. Simple but peaceful life with Raka.
endings.epilog_id: Dimas dan Raka makan malam bersama. Radio berita menyebut kebakaran di desa sebelah. Dunia tetap berputar.
endings.epilog_en: Dimas and Raka have dinner together. Radio news mentions fire in neighboring village. The world keeps turning.

endings.description_id: Konfrontasi dini tanpa bukti cukup. Dimas lari ke hutan dan tidak kembali. Raka menyesal seumur hidup.
endings.description_en: Early confrontation without enough evidence. Dimas runs into forest and never returns. Raka regrets forever.
endings.epilog_id: Raka berdiri di pemakaman. Warga bilang Dimas kelelahan dan terjebak kabut. Tidak ada yang tahu kebenarannya.
endings.epilog_en: Raka stands at funeral. Villagers say Dimas exhausted and trapped in fog. No one knows the truth.

endings.description_id: Raka menyelamatkan Dimas dan melaporkan. Keadilan terlaksana tapi pahit. Dimas dipenjara, Rudi dicari.
endings.description_en: Raka saves Dimas and reports. Justice served but bitter. Dimas imprisoned, Rudi wanted.
endings.rudiFate_en: Wanted by police after Raka's testimony
endings.epilog_id: Dimas di penjara. Raka mengunjungi. Jasad Joy ditemukan. Rudi kabur.
endings.epilog_en: Dimas in prison. Raka visits. Joy's body found. Rudi fled.

endings.description_id: Raka menyelamatkan Dimas tapi diam. Keduanya bersembunyi dalam rasa bersalah. Ikatan darah mengalahkan keadilan.
endings.description_en: Raka saves Dimas but stays silent. Both hide in guilt. Blood ties defeat justice.
endings.epilog_id: Dimas dan Raka pergi ke kota lain. Setiap malam Dimas mimpi Joy. Raka tahu tapi diam.
endings.epilog_en: Dimas and Raka move to another city. Every night Dimas dreams of Joy. Raka knows but stays silent.

endings.description_id: Raka memilih biarkan. Api memakan Dimas. Balas budi dari arwah Joy. Raka pulang sendirian.
endings.description_en: Raka chooses to let go. Fire consumes Dimas. Retribution from Joy's spirit. Raka returns alone.
endings.epilog_id: Api ilusi memakan Dimas. Raka pulang sendirian. Senandung Joy berhenti.
endings.epilog_en: Illusion fire consumes Dimas. Raka returns alone. Joy's humming stops.

endings.name_en: Light at the End of Smoke (True Ending)
endings.description_id: Semua clue terkumpul, empati penuh, nurani Dimas pulih. Penebusan penuh. Dimas dipenjara tapi bertobat, Rudi tertangkap, cukong diselidiki.
endings.description_en: All clues gathered, full empathy, Dimas's conscience restored. Full redemption. Dimas imprisoned but repentant, Rudi caught, mastermind investigated.
endings.epilog_id: Ruang kunjungan penjara. Ladang tumbuh kembali. Siluet Joy tersenyum lalu hilang. Koran: "Pemilik lahan diperiksa".
endings.epilog_en: Prison visiting room. Field grows back. Joy's silhouette smiles then fades. Newspaper: "Land owner under investigation".

endings.description_id: Nurani Dimas pulih di patroli. Dia berhenti dan mengaku sendiri di hadapan warga. Keadilan dari dalam.
endings.description_en: Dimas's conscience restored during patrol. He stops and confesses before villagers. Justice from within.
endings.epilog_id: Dimas mengakui segalanya di hadapan warga. Joy ditemukan. Rudi tertangkap.
endings.epilog_en: Dimas confesses everything before villagers. Joy found. Rudi arrested.

endings.description_id: Keyakinan Raka rendah. Dia pulang ke kota tanpa tahu kebenaran. Misteri tak terselesaikan.
endings.description_en: Raka's certainty low. Returns to city not knowing truth. Mystery unsolved.
endings.epilog_id: Raka di kota dapat telepon. Dimas meninggal. Raka tidak pernah tahu mengapa.
endings.epilog_en: Raka in city gets call. Dimas dead. Raka never knows why.

endings.description_id: Raka percaya Rudi. Dimas dan Rudi kabur bersama di hari 6. Raka ditinggal sendirian di desa.
endings.description_en: Raka trusts Rudi. Dimas and Rudi flee together on Day 6. Raka left alone in village.
endings.epilog_id: Mobil Rudi melaju malam hari. Dimas di sampingnya. Raka menatap rearview mirror. Asap di ujung jalan.
endings.epilog_en: Rudi's car speeds at night. Dimas beside him. Raka watches rearview mirror. Smoke at road's end.
